description: This module allows retrieving Xfce 4 configurations with the help of xfconf-query.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: A Xfconf preference channel is a top-level tree key, inside of the Xfconf repository that corresponds to the location for which all application properties/keys are stored. If not provided, the module lists all available channels.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: A Xfce preference key is an element in the Xfconf repository that corresponds to an application preference. If provided, then channel is required. If not provided and a channel is provided, then the module lists all available properties in that channel.

examples:
- name: Get list of all available channels
  community.general.xfconf_info: {}
  register: result

- name: Get list of all properties in a specific channel
  community.general.xfconf_info:
    channel: xsettings
  register: result

- name: Retrieve the DPI value
  community.general.xfconf_info:
    channel: xsettings
    property: /Xft/DPI
  register: result

- name: Get workspace names (4)
  community.general.xfconf_info:
    channel: xfwm4
    property: /general/workspace_names
  register: result

return_values.name: channels
return_values.description: List of available channels. Returned when the module receives no parameter at all. Returned: success Sample: ["xfce4-desktop", "displays", "xsettings", "xfwm4"]

return_values.name: is_array
return_values.description: Flag indicating whether the property is an array or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: properties
return_values.description: List of available properties for a specific channel. Returned by passing only the channel parameter to the module. Returned: success Sample: ["/Gdk/WindowScalingFactor", "/Gtk/ButtonImages", "/Gtk/CursorThemeSize", "/Gtk/DecorationLayout", "/Gtk/FontName", "/Gtk/MenuImages", "/Gtk/MonospaceFontName", "/Net/DoubleClickTime", "/Net/IconThemeName", "/Net/ThemeName", "/Xft/Antialias", "/Xft/Hinting", "/Xft/HintStyle", "/Xft/RGBA"]

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The value of the property. Empty if the property is of array type. Returned: success Sample: "Monospace 10"

return_values.name: value_array
return_values.description: The array value of the property. Empty if the property is not of array type. Returned: success Sample: ["Main", "Work", "Tmp"]

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: The version of the xfconf-query command. Returned: success Sample: "4.18.1"
